name: Chloe
label: UI-frustrated recommendations fan
who: I have used Spotify for years for its recommendations and playlists, and I listen to it nearly every day, including podcasts. I do not say which plan I am on, but I care about finding new music quickly and being able to navigate the app without fighting its layout.
value_for_money: Values Spotify mainly for its recommendations, playlists, and feature range, and says it is the most feature-rich service, but feels the app has got worse with each redesign; has considered paying for Pandora as an alternative.
loyalty: Recommendations, playlists for almost anything, and podcasts in the same app keep them on Spotify; they have said they would move to YouTube Music or another service if the UI and recommendations kept getting worse.
pain_points: Constant UI redesigns make the app confusing
Liking songs and finding library items takes more steps
likes: Podcasts and music in one app
tone: Blunt and exasperated, with casual profanity and emphatic statements.
